title: Blinking colon heartbeat
description: No seconds are added. Instead the existing HH:MM colon blinks on a 1s cadence (step function, 50% duty), a classic digital-clock "alive" cue that needs no new markup width.
warning: This is a CSS keyframe animation (opacity toggling on a fixed 1s cycle), not a TransitionGroup-driven list transition, so it is unaffected by the no-TransitionGroup constraint; noted for completeness per the motion-tile rule.

changes.intent: Isolate the colon in its own element so only it can be targeted by the blink animation, leaving the HH and MM digits static.
changes.detail: Change the HH:MM text inside .screen__clock-time from a plain string to `{{ hours }}:{{ minutes }}`, e.g. `22:40`.

changes.intent: Blink the colon once per second as a low-key indicator that the clock is ticking, without adding numeric seconds.
changes.detail: Add a `@keyframes clock-colon-blink { 0%, 49% { opacity: 1; } 50%, 100% { opacity: 0; } }` rule alongside the existing keyframes in main.css.
